title: Marathon Pace Calculator
description: Turn a goal finish time into the exact pace per km and per mile you must hold for any race distance.
howto: Pick your race distance (or enter a custom one).
Read the required pace per km, per mile and your average speed.

faqs.q: What is a realistic marathon goal for a beginner?
faqs.a: Most first-timers aim to finish strong around 4:30–5:30, which is roughly 6:24–7:50 per km. Train at goal pace in long runs.
Even pacing (same pace every km) is the most efficient strategy for most runners. This tool gives you that even-split target.

faqs.q: How do I convert pace to speed?
faqs.a: Speed (km/h) = 60 ÷ pace in min/km. A 6:00/km pace is 10 km/h.
